Face lock test

Measures how well on-device face recognition identifies an enrolled person as they move away. Everything runs on this phone: camera frames and face data are never uploaded or saved, and are gone when you reload.

Tap Start camera.

No face yet——

1 · Enrol

Fill the frame with one face, type a name and tap Enrol. For 6 seconds slowly turn your head left, right and down, and raise your phone the way you hold it in a match. Enrol a second person too, so you can see whether it tells you apart.

2 · Measure range

Point the camera at the enrolled person (or prop the phone up and walk away from the front camera). At each distance enter the metres, pick who is in view, and tap Record for a 5-second measurement.

m
Distance · whoFace foundRightWrongScoreFace pxms

Score is the distance between faces: 0 is identical, different people sit around 1.2 to 1.4, and under 1.0 can count as the same person. A name is only shown once 3 of the last 5 frames agree, and never for faces under 32 px wide. “Right” is the share of frames identified as the chosen person; “Wrong” is identified as someone else, which should stay at 0%.
